title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
summary: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
summary: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
summary: The Democratic ranking member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations asked Paolo Ardoino for records related to a reported deal between Tether and Nxum.

title: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations
summary: The SEC’s latest priorities highlight tokenization as an emerging market risk, while cryptocurrencies remain absent as a standalone examination category.

title: Bitcoin seeks support above $81K as Brent crude oil hits highest level since March
summary: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 as stocks fell and Brent crude hit its highest level since March, leaving the 50-day moving average in focus.

title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
summary: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.

title: Senate Democrat Probes Tether Payments to Ex-White House Crypto Adviser’s Firm
summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal demanded Tether’s records on payments to Nxum, a firm co-owned by former White House crypto adviser Bo Hines.

title: SpaceX Filing Gives Elon Musk the Final Word on Tesla Merger He Says He’s Staying Out Of
summary: SpaceX’s latest 10-Q filing quietly confirms any Tesla combination requires sign-off from its “controlling shareholder.”

title: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks
summary: The regulator's Division of Examinations named "super intelligence and other advanced technologies" as a focus area alongside tokenization risks.

title: How I Vibe Coded My Smart TV—And Claude Killed It
summary: Vibe coding your TV is impressive. Doing it without knowing exactly what you're touching is how you lose a rooted LG set and get a very sincere apology from an AI.

title: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt
summary: Developers will now backport fixes and cut releases immediately for flaws flagged as “easily discoverable,” abandoning long embargoes for bugs an attacker can surface with a single AI prompt.

title: Crypto Scammers Who Used Prayer Groups to Lure Victims Must Pay $1.3 Billion, Says New York
summary: New York’s attorney general asked a court to order NovaTech’s founders, who fled the country, to pay about $1.37 billion, and settled with four top promoters for nearly $6 million.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $636 Million as October Turns Red Again
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $635.6 million on Thursday, their biggest outflow of the month, pushing October flows back to a loss of about $176 million as Ethereum and Solana funds also bled.

title: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East a competitive edge, says Apex Group CEO
summary: Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes warned that the failure of the U.S. Clarity Act will drive digital asset businesses toward faster-moving jurisdictions in Asia and the Middle East.

title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
summary: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.

title: Hong Kong’s Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
summary: HSBC switched on its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin inside PayMe on Friday, testing whether a bank-issued token can become everyday money.

title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
summary: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.

title: Bitcoin’s wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
summary: Borrowing against bitcoin and earning income to build their BTC holdings are becoming priorities for long-term investors, Xapo Bank CEO Seamus Rocca told CoinDesk.

title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
summary: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
summary: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

title: Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says
summary: Robert Bowling, who spent six years working on Call of Duty, told Decrypt that Activision suggested cutting discs nearly two decades ago.

title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears
